title: Amnesty Alleges Crimes Against Humanity in Sudan's El Fasher
summary: Amnesty International has alleged that Sudan's Rapid Support Forces committed crimes against humanity and ethnic cleansing during its seizure of the city of el-Fasher. The allegations add to evidence of atrocities in the region, which have been described as bearing the hallmarks of genocide by the UN. The report raises concerns about human rights abuses and the need for accountability.
summary_points: Amnesty International has alleged that Sudan's Rapid Support Forces committed crimes against humanity and ethnic cleansing in el-Fasher.
The allegations add to evidence of atrocities in the region, which have been described as bearing the hallmarks of genocide by the UN.
The report raises concerns about human rights abuses and the need for accountability.
The UN has previously described the situation in el-Fasher as bearing the hallmarks of genocide.
The allegations come amid a long-running civil war between Sudan's military and the Rapid Support Forces.
